VARIABLE.NAME: Trial1Assessment
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: definition=One documented prior antipsychotic trial. Adequate: therapeutic dose for at least 6 weeks with adherence at least 80 percent, supported by adherence evidence. Suboptimal includes partial response with persistent significant symptoms. If prematurely truncated by intolerance, select TruncatedByIntolerance even if exposure also inadequate; otherwise insufficient dose/duration/adherence is InadequateExposure. Record drug, dates, dose, scale, blood-level and multiple-source adherence evidence. This is a modeler operationalization, not the entire TRRIP definition.
missingness_policy=Leave unobserved when unavailable; absence of documentation is not a negative finding
time_window=Current review with explicitly documented historical trial dates
parameter_requirement=4 prior entries; population data or elicitation required after dependence review
